connect.title: Connect Mailchimp Transactional
connect.summary: Owlat sends through your existing Mandrill account first, so day one carries your current reputation, not a cold one.

history.title: Carry over contacts and suppressions
history.summary: Import the audience, then the unsubscribes and hard bounces Mandrill and Mailchimp accumulated — mailing someone who opted out is how a migration fails on day one.

domain.title: Verify the sending domain at Mandrill
domain.summary: Mandrill rejects mail from a domain it has not verified, so the reference arm cannot carry traffic — and the ramp has nothing to measure against — until this clears.

preset.title: Apply the migration preset
preset.summary: All three message types move to the measured split: 100% Mandrill today, and the ramp controller grows your own MTA’s share cell by cell from there.

watch.title: Watch the ramp
watch.summary: Every decision the controller makes is on the cells screen, in a sentence. Pause, pin or promote any cell at any time.

blocked.history: Connect Mailchimp Transactional first — the reject-list import reads the same key.
blocked.presetDomain: Finish Mandrill’s domain verification first — the preset would name a relay that cannot send.
blocked.watch: Apply the preset first — there is no ramp to watch yet.

remediation.sourceAddress: Assign and route the IPv6 address on the MTA host/container, then run readiness again.
remediation.spf: Publish the generated ip6: mechanism on the return-path domain, then verify again.
remediation.ipv4: Repair the IPv4 PTR, forward A record, and EHLO alignment before enabling IPv6.
remediation.blocklist: Review the MTA blocklist details, resolve the listing cause, and request delisting.
remediation.hetzner: In Hetzner Console, open Servers → your server → Networking → Primary IP → Edit reverse DNS.
remediation.digitalocean: In the DigitalOcean control panel, rename the Droplet to the EHLO hostname; DigitalOcean uses that name for reverse DNS.
remediation.ovh: In OVHcloud Manager, open Network → Public IP Addresses → the IP menu → Modify reverse DNS.
remediation.generic: Open your VPS provider’s reverse-DNS/PTR settings for this public IP.
